title: w3commerce
tagline: Buy togethe, save together, fun together and earn together with us
description:
We build this w3ecommercer because there are not that decentralized e-commerce platforms so we wanna make a completely decentralized system and that's why we use all the web3 protocols that support that direction.

web3 at its core is about privacy and buying things online is a very personal thing no one wanna know what you why and why you need it 

Our website also supports users to get the advantage of when traffic on certain products is higher then normal or they ask their firend to buy product together by broadcasting real time users
how_its_made:
Tech we used is Tableland for making a decentralized database so no one can drop any sellers product as of now there is no seller onboarding system but once it's there and can sell their product without dependent on 3rd party 

using Streamer for broadcasting real-time uses and helping users to buy socially

Unstoppable domains for easy and simple login flow which is really important for mass web3 adoption

using Valist for publishing my app

polygon for the blockchain because it's the cheap transaction fee
